brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished an inhabited residential home in Kafr al-Dik, a Palestinian village west of Salfit, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation displaced the residents from their dwelling in the occupied West Bank locality.

Kafr al-Dik has faced repeated demolitions of Palestinian-owned structures, with Israeli authorities citing lack of building permits as justification. The village lies in an area classified under Israeli military control.
title: Israeli forces demolish inhabited home in Kafr al-Dik west of Salfit
